title: Terraform resource ID
summary: A Terraform resource ID is a provider-specific string that uniquely identifies a managed resource. Format varies by provider: AWS uses ARNs, Azure uses Azure resource IDs, GCP uses GCP resource names, etc. Terraform stores the ID in state for import and updates.

notes: The ID is used for import (terraform import) and for detecting drift.
Terraform state maps resource addresses (e.g., aws_instance.web) to resource IDs.
